description: Effect-render integration test — first GPU golden coverage of PASS 1.5. Imports a mid-tone still on one 64x64 screen, captures the clean compose target (effect_off golden), then adds core.gaussian_blur via script index addressing, sets radius via SetEffectFloatParam, and asserts the composed output matches the effect_on golden. Regression gate for AddEffect -> bake (PlaybackTimeAuthority effect fold-in) -> CompositorSystem PASS 1.5 -> D3D12Renderer::drawEffectPass. Goldens recorded on this machine class (WARP); regenerate with scripts/integration/record_effect_blur.json and copy test_output/effect_blur/*.hash into tests/goldens/effect_blur/.
